market.question: Will Trump try to leave the USMCA before 2027?
market.rules_summary: Yes if the United States submits a notice of withdrawal from the USMCA before Jan 1, 2027.

impact.formula: Vehicles: 205,288 Hermosillo Maverick + Bronco Sport US sales Jan-Jul 2025 x 12/7 = ~352k a year x ~$25k import value x 25% Sec. 232 x ~50% of value not tariffed today (USMCA vehicles pay only on non-US content) = ~$1.1B; plus Mexican and Canadian engines and parts losing USMCA treatment: Reuters reports tighter content rules alone would cost Ford >= $2B a year, so withdrawal is taken at ~$2.0B central, up to ~$3.5B before mitigation
impact.timing: from about mid-2027 (withdrawal takes effect 6 months after notice)
